rationale: This is fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets and interior surfaces, caused by an accident on their premises—a covered property damage peril.
claim_summary: Grease fire on kitchen stove with charred cabinets and smoke damage; claimant controlled fire with extinguisher; no injuries; estimated moderate damage (medium severity).

case_facts.description: cabinets above stove are charred, smoke damage on ceiling and walls, fire extinguished by claimant
case_facts.damage_scope: kitchen only, rest of house unaffected

rationale: Water damage from a burst pipe on the policyholder's own property is the policyholder's responsibility and falls squarely under property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Basement flood from burst water supply line; two inches of standing water, buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall up to one foot, and ruined stored boxes.

case_facts.incident_description: Basement flooded with approximately two inches of water
case_facts.damage_details: Hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked up to one foot high, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.discovery_context: Discovered upon return from work trip

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof is straightforward property damage to the insured structure.
claim_summary: Four roof shingles blown off back porch overhang by wind; $400 estimated repair cost, below $2,500 deductible.
